title: Hazard visible: Grey car
detail: First seen 35 m ahead, 11.3 m left of the camera's line, with the camera vehicle at 41 km/h.

title: Braking began 1.5 s before impact
detail: At 46 km/h with 24.3 m left to the impact point. The rider was already braking 0.6 s before Grey car came into the lane.

title: Slowing began before the hazard became critical
detail: The camera vehicle was already slowing 1.5 s before impact, before the time-to-collision fell below 3 s.

title: Time-to-collision below 3.0 s
detail: 9.6 m apart and closing at 14 km/h at T-1.1 s.

title: Time-to-collision below 1.5 s
detail: 9.2 m apart and closing at 34 km/h at T-1.0 s.

title: Vision model's reading
detail: The grey car cut into the camera vehicle's lane, forcing the motorcycle to collide with it. The motorcycle then slid off the road and came to rest on the shoulder. This agrees with the measurements.

title: Grey car moved into the camera vehicle's lane
detail: It came 11.3 m across from the left (T-3.6 s) to 1.0 m off the camera's line by T-0.9 s, 7 m ahead.

title: Could the rider have avoided it?
detail: When Grey car entered the lane 0.9 s before impact it was 7.2 m ahead and the gap was closing at about 20 km/h. Avoiding contact needed about 7.9 m (1 s reaction + braking): there wasn't room. The vehicle moving into the lane and slowing ahead is what made the crash unavoidable.

title: Grey car ahead at ≈ 40 km/h
detail: In the last 1.5 s the camera vehicle (61 km/h) was closing on it at about 20 km/h, so it was doing about 40 km/h.

title: Speed before impact ≈ 65 ± 22 km/h
detail: Average speed of the camera vehicle over the last second, estimated from how fast the road surface streams past (±30%).

title: Closest approach: Grey car
detail: Grey car came within 1.5 m of White motorcycle's body (2.5 m centre to centre) at T+0.0 s.
